description: Views shared by the calls Resenha's server answers.

bookView.description: Enough of a book to show a row. Cover and details come from BookHive's catalogue when the server has them; otherwise the app asks BookHive itself.

hiveId.description: The book's BookHive ID, or, for a Popfeed book BookHive's catalogue doesn't know, a stand-in beginning with popfeed- that no BookHive call takes.

isbn13.description: The edition the reader's record names, when it names one. For a book BookHive's catalogue doesn't know, the key of the page its readers share (ink.resenha.book.getBook).

authors.description: Authors as BookHive stores them, tab-separated.

cover.description: For a Popfeed book, Popfeed's own cover, its surest address.

covers.description: For a Popfeed book, every address of its cover, surest first, when there is more than one: the poster blob's address on Bluesky's CDN, isbndb's, then the item's posterUrl. A reader tries the next when one fails.

year.description: Year of publication, from BookHive's catalogue.

event.description: Something a reader did with a book.

uri.description: The record it comes from: the reader's BookHive book record, or their Popfeed list item (or review, for a book reviewed but on no list).

kind.description: What they did. wantsToRead and abandoned are dated by when the server saw the status change, else by when the book was added; progress by the record.

stars.description: In half stars, 1 to 10, as BookHive keeps them.

excerpt.description: The start of the review, plain text.

review.description: The whole review, plain markdown, on reviewed events and on finished ones that carry the review.

cid.description: The record's version as the server last saw it, for a like or comment to name.

likeCount.description: Likes in the event's home: Resenha likes on the reader's book record for a reading or a review kept on BookHive, Popfeed likes on a Popfeed review, Bluesky likes on the post that announced a review published from Resenha.

commentCount.description: Comments in the event's home: the thread about the reader reading this book (Resenha comments and BookHive buzzes) for a reading or a review kept on BookHive, Popfeed's comments and replies on a Popfeed review, replies to the post of a review published from Resenha.

popfeedReview.description: For a reviewed event from Popfeed: the social.popfeed.feed.review record, whose comments and likes are Popfeed's.

post.description: For a reviewed event with source resenha: the Bluesky post that announced the review, whose likes and replies are the review's.

uri.description: The review: a Standard.site document, a Popfeed review, or a BookHive book record with a review.

text.description: The whole review, when asked for with full.

followedAt.description: When the caller followed them, for the caller's own list.

booksInCommon.description: With the caller, when sorted by similar.

books.description: How many books they keep on BookHive.

lastActivity.description: When they last started, finished, changed or progressed in a book.

followsYou.description: Whether they follow the caller, as the server knows it.

progressView.description: How far through the book the reader is, as the record says.

profileView.description: Someone's name and picture, as Bluesky's AppView last gave them to the server; absent for a reader it hasn't fetched yet, whose name the app then finds itself.

followedAt.description: When they followed, when the server heard the follow itself; absent for follows older than its listening.

follows.description: Whether the caller follows them back.

books.description: How many books they keep in the index; 0 for someone who isn't a reader.

suggestionView.description: A reader worth following, for an empty Parlor.

source.description: Where they read: Resenha's readers come first, then BookHive's and Popfeed's.

activeDays.description: Days over the last six months on which they started, finished, changed, progressed in or reviewed a book, on any source.

languages.description: The languages they said their reviews are in.

starterPackView.description: A starter pack the server keeps in the official account.

list.description: The reference list the pack is built on.

viewerState.description: The caller's own reactions to a book record.

like.description: The caller's like, to take it back.

commentView.description: A comment in the thread about a reader reading a book.

source.description: A Resenha comment, or a BookHive buzz, which is read here but answered on BookHive.

parent.description: The comment this one answers; absent at the top.

removed.description: Removed by Resenha's maintainer but kept in place because replies hang from it: no words, no author.

knownFollowers.description: Among the caller's follows, who follows a reader: social proof within Resenha's community, from the follows and followers the server keeps.

followers.description: Up to three of them, to name.

reportView.description: A reported, or removed, Resenha comment as the maintainers see it.

text.description: The comment's words, as the index keeps them.

subject.description: The book record the thread is on.

subjectTitle.description: That book's title, when the index has it.

bookIdentifiers.description: A book's numbers in every catalogue that has it. Any one of them finds the book; together they tie the catalogues to each other.

openLibraryWork.description: Open Library's work key, such as /works/OL45908582W: the book across its editions.

openLibraryEdition.description: Open Library's edition key, such as /books/OL62590811M.

shopId.description: An edition in Resenha's Shop, such as se:jane-austen_pride-and-prejudice or pg:1342.

bookRef.description: Which book a record is about, in every key anyone uses, so an app finds it with the one it has: by BookHive ID, ISBN, Open Library work, or the reader's own record in another app. Resenha's records carry it beside their own keys. Nothing is required but the title, so a book no catalogue knows can still be named.

records.description: The reader's own records for the book in any app: their buzz.bookhive.book, their social.popfeed.feed.listItem records, a record in an app to come.

cover.description: A cover the writer's app showed for the book, downloaded and found to be a real cover rather than a catalogue's stand-in picture. Resenha's server keeps it as a fallback for the book's cover, after the catalogue's and Open Library's.
